host_note: Murayama (1928:286) documented attacked trees from Taichu Province, Taiwan; the botanical names have been normalized with the original spellings retained in the source records.
taxonomy_summary: Platypus horishensis Murayama, 1928. Original publication and subsequent nomenclatural qualifications are documented below.

taxonomic_history.name: Platypus horishensis
taxonomic_history.note: Original account pp. 284–286; original name and description verified.

nomenclature_note: The original description and associated trees attacked are directly verified from Murayama (1928:284–286). The original female association was described as probable.
